parameters.parameter: Number of Fill Positions for Cylinders
Water Capacity of Cylinder that can be filled using Breathing Air Cylinder Fill Containment Cabinet (In Liter)

parameters.value: Fill Station connected to Compressor with high- pressure breathing air hose(s)

The fill station containment cabinet shall totally enclose the SCBA (Self-contained Breathing Apparatus) cylinders during the refilling process. The fill station containment cabinets shall contain the cylinder and any fragments of the failed breathing air cylinder and vent the expanding air away from the operator in the unlikely event of a cylinder rupturing while being filled. Breathing Air Cylinder Fill Containment Cabinet shall have the provision to restrict the entry of reptile/rodent and other external elements in fill containment cabinet.

parameters.parameter: Equipment / Accessories to be supplied with Breathing Air Cylinder Fill Containment Cabinet
parameters.value: Pressure gauges, pressure regulating devices, fill rate measuring and regulating devices on each fill hose. Fill hoses equipped with a bleed valve and suitable SCBA cylinder fill adapters. Adapter to anchor the fill hoses when not in use.
Cabinet door and cylinder holder assembly shall tilt out at suitable height to the operator for unobstructed loading and unloading of the cylinder.
lined with ABS plastic strip to prevent scuffing the outer surface of the SCBA cylinders.
Breathing Air Cylinder Fill Containment Cabinet shall have the provision to prevent Cylinder from being refilled unless the fill station is in the cylinder fill operation position.
